procedure_name: Pet Shop & Dog Breeding Establishment License
summary: Mandatory license under Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (Pet Shop & Dog Breeding) Rules.

steps.title: Facility standard compliance
steps.description: Ensure adequate enclosure dimensions, temperature regulation, quarantine cages, and sanitary ventilation.

steps.title: Submit Form I to State Animal Welfare Board
steps.description: Apply online with photographs of housing pens, grooming areas, and waste disposal mechanisms.

steps.title: Veterinary inspection committee
steps.description: Authorized veterinary officer inspects animal welfare protocols, microchipping, and vaccination logs.

steps.title: Certificate grant
steps.description: Receive Animal Welfare Board registration certificate valid for 2 calendar years.
